subject: Logo crediting, embargo date and Order Form publicity language
messages:
From: Sara Mills <sara.mills@nimbus-sys.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Logo use & press quote for upcoming product announcement

Hi Kimberly,

Hope you’re well — we’re planning a press announcement for our new integration with Redwood on July 30 and wanted to confirm a couple of publicity items before we lock down copy:

- Permission to use the Redwood logo in our press release and on the product page (SVG and PNG).
- A short quote from a Redwood exec (one-liner) that we can include.
- An embargo until 07/30 at 9:00 AM PDT.

Our procurement team indicated that we should formalize the logo/quote permissions in the Order Form rather than only in the MSA. Can you confirm whether Redwood is comfortable with an explicit line in the Order Form granting non-exclusive publicity and logo use limited to the announcement and a follow-up case study? If so, can you share the language you prefer or have your legal team redline the Order Form?

I’ve attached our draft press template for context.

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Mills
Head of Corporate Communications
Nimbus Systems
[sent with attachment: Nimbus_press_template.pdf]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Sara Mills <sara.mills@nimbus-sys.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Logo use & press quote for upcoming product announcement

Hi Sara — great to hear, congratulations on the launch timing.

We’re generally open to the permission you describe but we need to capture a few guardrails in the Order Form: embargo timing, a simple attribution line, and a narrow permission scope (press release + case study). I’m looping in Markus (legal) and Lauren (partnerships) to confirm specifics and run a quick redline.

Can you confirm:
1) Will the announcement include any claims about performance or pricing tied to Redwood?
2) Do you need permission to use the Redwood logo on Nimbus marketing beyond the release (e.g., customer logos page)?
3) Who will sign the Order Form on your side and do you have a DocuSign link?

I’m attaching the Order Form you sent — Markus, can you take a first pass on an Order Form clause we can propose back?

Thanks — I’ll coordinate asset delivery from Marketing as soon as legal confirms.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Strategic Partnerships, Redwood Inference
[sent with attachment: OrderForm_Nimbus_20260710.docx]

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Mills <sara.mills@nimbus-sys.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Logo use & press quote for upcoming product announcement — proposed redlines

Kimberly / Lauren —

Thanks for the ping. I reviewed the Order Form and the standard MSA publicity clause. High-level position we can accept, subject to the following redlines (attached as Nimbus_MSA_redline_v2.pdf):

1) Scope: Limit publicity rights to (a) a single press release announcing the integration and (b) a single written case study and related landing page. No broad marketing use beyond these items without a separate written permission.

2) Logo assets: Right to use provided logo files (SVg/PNG) only; Redwood retains all IP in the marks and may require usage guidelines to be followed (colors, clearspace).

3) Confidentiality carve-out: Any customer-specific confidential data, benchmarks, or metrics may not be published without prior written approval. If Nimbus wants to include performance numbers, we require Redwood to review and approve the final copy.

4) Attribution language: We propose the following insertion in the Order Form under "Publicity":
   "Customer may include Redwood Inference's name and logo in a press release announcing the commercial use of Redwood's services. Any case study or use of Redwood's name/logo beyond the press release requires Redwood's prior written approval, not to be unreasonably withheld.
   Redwood will have ten (10) business days to review and approve any draft quote or case study and may request reasonable edits for accuracy and confidentiality."

5) Embargo: We can agree to an embargo until 2026-07-30 09:00 AM PDT, provided Redwood receives the final release draft 3 business days prior to that time for review.

6) No implied endorsement: Add language clarifying that use of the logo and quote does not constitute an endorsement of Nimbus' products beyond the factual announcement.

If those points are acceptable, I can convert the redline into a short Order Form addendum and circulate for signature. Please confirm whether Nimbus needs a perpetual right for the case study (we prefer a 24-month term).

Attaching the redline: Nimbus_MSA_redline_v2.pdf.

-Markus
Markus Klein
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
[sent with attachment: Nimbus_MSA_redline_v2.pdf]

From: Sara Mills <sara.mills@nimbus-sys.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Legal Ops <legal-ops@nimbus-sys.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Logo use & press quote — clarifications

Thanks Markus — that reads reasonable. A couple of clarifications from our side:

- We don’t plan to publish any performance benchmarks in the initial release; the copy will be factual and high level.
- For long-term marketing (customer logos page) we would like a standing permission, but we can treat that as a separate request after the announcement.
- We can agree to the 24-month window for the case study.

Legal Ops has a signed contact name (Maya Ortiz) and I’m dropping a DocuSign link for the order form here: https://docusign.com/txn/3c4f-nimbus-orderform.

We’ve also attached a slightly edited press template (sent earlier) — happy to share the final draft 48 hours before the embargo for Redwood review.

Appreciate the quick turn here.

—Sara
Sara Mills
Head of Corporate Communications
Nimbus Systems

Sara — thanks, this is helpful and we have a clear path. Summary / next steps: 

1) Legal (Markus) will convert the proposed language into a short addendum to the Order Form (reflecting the scope, 24-month case study term, embargo and 10-business-day review window). Expect the PDF redline and addendum by end of day tomorrow.
2) Nimbus will complete the DocuSign envelope (Maya Ortiz as signee) and return the signed Order Form.
3) Marketing will share approved logo assets and brand guidelines once the addendum is executed; please send the final release draft at least 72 hours before planned embargo for review.
4) Redwood confirms the embargo window: 2026-07-30 09:00 AM PDT.

Attachments/links referenced above: Nimbus_MSA_redline_v2.pdf, OrderForm_Nimbus_20260710.docx, Nimbus_press_template.pdf, DocuSign: https://docusign.com/txn/3c4f-nimbus-orderform, Drive: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a2bNIMBUS-press-template
